newsitem.title: TURKEY: Airbus delegation in Turkey for talks.
newsitem.headline: Airbus delegation in Turkey for talks.

text.p: A delegation from Airbus Industrie has arrived in Turkey for talks on joint passenger aircraft production, state-run Anatolian news agency reported on Friday.
It said the delegation arrived in Ankara on Thursday for talks with officials from Turkish Aerospace Industries (TAI).
The agency said Airbus would seek an agreement under which the national carrier Turkish Airlines (THY) would order aircraft from the European consortium.

Turkish Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan said earlier this year Turkey was planning to buy 50 civil aircraft worth a total $4 billion in an offset agreement, under which Turkey would manufacture half the parts for the planes.
Turkey has also been assessing cooperation proposals by McDonnell Douglas Corp and Lockheed Martin Corp.
